itinerary: To depart for Hue tour from Da Nang, tour guide will come and pick you up from your hotel in Da Nang. To come to Hue city, we will go through Hai Van tunnel – the longest tunnel in South East Asia.

On the way to for Hue tour from Da Nang, our group will stop at Lang Co Bay – one of the most beautiful beach in Vietnam with white sand and long seashore covering the blue water of the ocean to take some amazing picture.

+ When arriving in Hue city, we will take you to the first attraction in our journey – Khai Dinh Tomb. This tomb is considered the most beautiful among the tombs in Hue with the mixture of Eastern and Western style of architecture representing the transition to French colonialism

+ Leaving Khai Dinh tomb, you wil continue to visit Thien Mu pagoda. Having the ancient beauty with spacious garden, pure scenery, along with the highlight of 7-floor Phuoc Duyen tower on the front yard, this pagoda has always been the featured icon of Hue tourism.
Have lunch and take some rest at local restaurant in Hue.
We will take you to Hue Imperial city – the former administrative center as well as the accommodation of 13 Kings of the Nguyen Dynasty – the last feudatory Empire of Vietnam.

The Imperial city is preserved as new for hundreds years, and tourists are allowed to visit many places such as Meridian Gate, Thai Hoa Palace and Duyet Thi duong theatre. Our tour guide will tell you the secret stories of the Royal family, of the Kings and the Queens’ lives.

Our group will gater at the bus station and our tour guide will take you back to Da Nang city. We drop you off at the hotel, end of our Hue tour 1 day with lots of memories. Say goodby to you and hope to see you in other adventure with Da Nang Local Tours.
